draft.emotion: firm and decisive, making a clear end to an action
notes: To say 'to stop doing something' or 'to quit', use the preposition 'met': 'stoppen met werken' (to stop working), 'stoppen met roken' (to quit smoking).
In the perfect tense, 'stoppen' takes 'zijn' when it means to halt or quit ('De trein is gestopt'), and 'hebben' when it means to put something inside ('Ik heb het in mijn tas gestopt').
